name: auto-coding
description: Lightweight complete delivery: plan outcomes, preserve boundaries and memory, verify behavior, and finish authorized work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, verify, and complete authorized outcomes.
interface.longDescription: A concise delivery framework for capable coding agents. It selects depth by actual risk, uses existing project plans and memory, completes required integration and in-scope repairs, and reconciles outcomes with verification evidence before stopping. Skills coordinate judgment; host and project rules control permissions. OpenSpec remains optional.
